title: Master transcription factor binding sites constitute the core of early replication control elements
authors: Jesse L. Turner; Laura Hinojosa-Gonzalez; Takayo Sasaki; Satoshi Uchino; Athanasios Vouzas; Mariella S. Soto; Abhijit Chakraborty; Karen E. Alexander; Cheryl A. Fitch; Amber N. Brown; Ferhat Ay; David M. Gilbert
one_liner_zh: 该文研究主转录因子结合位点构成早期复制控制元件核心，涉及TF-DNA结合位点与染色质结构，但核心是复制时序调控而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，且无AI或物理模拟方法。
abstract: Eukaryotic genomes replicate in a defined temporal order called the replication timing (RT) program. RT is developmentally regulated with potential to drive cell fate transitions, but mechanisms controlling RT remain elusive. We previously identified “Early Replication Control Elements” (ERCEs) necessary for early RT, domain-wide transcription, 3D chromatin architecture and compartmentalization in mouse embryonic stem cells (mESCs) but, deletions identifying ERCEs were large and encompassed many putative regulatory elements. Here, we show that ERCEs are compound elements whose RT activity can largely be accounted for by multiple sites of diverse master transcription factor binding (subERCEs), distinguished from other such sites by their long-range interactions. While deletion of subERCEs had large effects on both transcription and RT, deleting transcription start sites eliminated nearly all transcription with moderate effects on RT. Our results suggest a model in which subERCEs respond to diverse master transcription factors by functioning both as transcription enhancers and as elements that organize chromatin domains structurally and support early RT, potentially providing a feed-forward loop to drive robust epigenomic change during cell fate transitions.
abstract_zh: 真核生物基因组按照一种确定的时间顺序进行复制，这种顺序称为复制时序 (replication timing, RT) 程序。RT受发育调控，具有驱动细胞命运转变的潜力，但控制RT的机制仍难以捉摸。我们此前在小鼠胚胎干细胞 (mouse embryonic stem cells, mESCs) 中鉴定出早期复制控制元件 (Early Replication Control Elements, ERCEs)，这些元件对早期RT、全结构域转录、3D染色质结构和区室化是必需的，但鉴定ERCEs的缺失片段较大，且包含许多推定调控元件。在此，我们表明ERCEs是复合元件，其RT活性在很大程度上可由多种主转录因子结合位点（subERCEs）来解释，这些位点通过其长程相互作用与其他此类位点区分开来。虽然删除subERCEs对转录和RT均有显著影响，但删除转录起始位点几乎消除了所有转录，而对RT的影响则较为温和。我们的结果提出一个模型，其中subERCEs通过作为转录增强子和组织染色质结构域结构并支持早期RT的元件，响应多种主转录因子，从而可能在细胞命运转变期间提供前馈环路以驱动稳健的表观基因组变化。
